text:
jordan: quick design QA — on the inventory list when viewport is ~375px (iPhone/SE widths) the grid collapses and the right-side action drawer overlaps the last column. looks like the drawer z-index + compact row height are fighting. screenshot: https://img.redwood/test/ss-375.png
mei: ack, saw this in staging too. repro steps: open item, collapse sidebar, rotate to portrait, tap search. chips and badges clip into the overflow menu.
sam: possible quick fix: reduce row min-height from 56px -> 48px at <= 420px and force action drawer to full-width modal on narrow screens. code snippet we tested: ```@media (max-width:420px){ .row{min-height:48px} .side-drawer{position:fixed;right:0;left:0} }```
alex: prefer making it a full-screen sheet instead of modal for discoverability — also improves hit targets for the drawer close btn.
maya: accessibility nits: when drawer becomes full-screen the focus trap needs to announce "Item actions dialog" to SR users and close button must be 44px touch target. also ensure keyboard users can reach the overflow menu with tab sequence.
mei: copy tweak: change "More actions" -> "Actions" on small screens, shorter label avoids wrapping. also consider removing non-essential badges in compact mode (cost, tags) to reduce horizontal overflow.
jordan: nice. can we add a breakpoint at 360px to hide low-priority columns entirely? e.g., collapse "tags" and "region" into a details flyout.
sam: yeah, implement columns: visible at >= 768, reduced at 420-767, minimal at <420. i'll push a prototype.
design-bot: deploy preview available at https://staging.redwood/preview/tx-388 — uses compact rows + sheet drawer for <420.
maya: quick UX test idea: simulate 1-thumb navigation — are close icons and primary actions reachable by thumb when holding phone bottom-left? if not, consider moving primary action down.
jordan: good point. let's do a 3-person quick test tomorrow. sam can you add an a11y checklist in the PR?
sam: on it — will include: focus order, aria-labels for close, role=dialog + aria-modal, 44px touch targets, and SR announcement strings.
mei: leaving small visual tweak: drop shadow on sheet should be subtle (rgba(0,0,0,0.12)) — current shadow reads heavy on OLED.
jordan: thanks all. plan: sam prototype + PR, maya accessibility review, quick 3-person test. aim to ship next sprint. :thumbsup:
